text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road did it! Taking a 
magnificent victory in the "Japanese 
Derby", she wept tears of joy at having 
met everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the decisive battle, 
Narita Top Road conveys her gratitude to 
the two. In response, T.M. Opera O spoke 
of meeting again at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Admire Vega showed signs of 
bewilderment at Narita Top Road's way of 
"enjoying the race"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the grand finale of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho―― 
There, Narita Top Road will face off 
against her rivals once more.
